item.title: Sturgeon Bay… Hotspot for Art, Artists, and Galleries
item.description: Sturgeon Bay, the gateway to Door County has become an exciting art destination in recent years. With over a dozen galleries downtown showcasing work by local artists, it offers a vibrant arts and culture scene perfect for a weekend getaway. You can discover paintings, glass, pottery, jewelry and more without traveling up the peninsula. item.title: A Cherry Pie Christmas
item.description: How a Hallmark-Style Holiday Film Became a Love Letter to Door County When winter arrives in Door County, the pace slows, the landscape softens, and the peninsula takes on a quieter kind of magic. Snow settles into cherry orchards, harbors grow still, and small towns glow a little warmer against the cold. It is exactly this feeling that gives A Cherry Pie Christmas its charm.
